lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: Six rounds had the stranger, six rounds and no more, and the Cutters lay cold on the Tellico shore! Penny a sheet, patrons of letters, every word true or near enough to pass!

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: The stranger walked by with a hand on the gun, and the drover lay dead when the walking was done! Penny a sheet! What? I only print what I'm told.

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: ...and nobody asks where a stranger gets pay, when a wagon rides light on the Tellico way. It's only a song. Penny a sheet.

lines.speaker: talbot
lines.text: Billie Tarrow jumped a train over a hole. Over a HOLE. She told me herself. Well. She told the whole street, and I was standing in it.

lines.speaker: keene
lines.text: He'll keep the arm. He won't thank you for asking after him, so I'll do it for him: he is twenty-two, and he went because you would not.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: That silver case. Don't ask me in the street. Come by after dark, alone, and I'll tell you about a mould I ought never to have cut.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: Greenwater's signed with the Commonwealth. Whole town, for soup. Funny how a barge goes down in the Chute and a soup wagon turns up the same week. I'm not saying a thing. I'm only counting.

lines.speaker: pritchard
lines.text: Esther Quill sent me one line. I've had it nineteen years coming. ...You carried it, and you knew what it was. We'll talk about that. Not today.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Your Line 14 book is quite safe with me. I have read it twice. Somebody at that yard has a steady hand and a dead man's stamp. I do admire thrift.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: I hear the Night Mail had a difficult evening, and that somebody was paid for it in the Cut. Do not look alarmed. I am the last man in this valley to think the less of you.

lines.speaker: keene
lines.text: The physic came in on the Night Mail at dawn. Eleven children on my list. I had been choosing which four. I don't have to choose. Whoever you are, go and eat something.

lines.speaker: keene
lines.text: No Night Mail. No physic. I have eleven children on a list and enough for four. I am told somebody on that train was paid. I should like very much to be shown which somebody.
